dashboard.label: Firewall data source
dashboard.description: Where the network evidence pipeline reads permitted flows from, what counts as an entry point, and how fresh the data has to be.

div.b: Nothing here changes a priority. It decides what the app is allowed to say about the network.
div.span: With no index named, every Network evidence row reads unknown, which is the correct answer for a site that has not connected its firewall logs. Naming one lets the pipeline grade a port confirmed observed when a permitted flow from a declared entry point reached it, and, only where a constant pressure entry point is declared, not observed when none did. Test the mapping before saving: a source that yields no edges produces a page of unknowns that reads as a fact about the network.

Saving writes one settings stanza and regenerates the five riskability_fw_* macros from it through Splunk's configuration service, so on a search head cluster every member reads the same source. Edit the settings, not the macros.
